sources.dataQuality: The 10,741 dish records reduce to 10,723 normalized dish names, but they are not usable recipes: records include names and ingredient-name lists, no instruction fields. Ingredient records contain 535 duplicate normalized names and many ambiguous synonyms; dish records have 18 duplicate normalized names.
sources.notes: README says data was crawled from DienmayXanh, asks users to follow robots.txt and site terms, and limits the dataset to research and study. Do not import or rerun crawl without written redistribution permission.

sources.dataQuality: CSV fields are dish name, source, category, ingredient count, default serving mass/unit, age group and medical diet. There are 3,548 normalized dish names; 3,821 rows repeat a name, often across serving or age/diet variants. CSV does not contain ingredient names or methods, so independent recipe count is unknown.
sources.notes: The site says RNI formula details can include ingredients, weights and methods, but the RNI lookup source requires login. Only its public summary CSV was inspected. No license or redistribution terms found.

sources.dataQuality: CSV contains name, record type, source, category and nutrition per 100 g. Types: 1,717 fresh foods, 249 processed foods, 656 products, 1,057 cooked-dish nutrition records and 40 rows with blank type. The cooked-dish records are nutrition-only, not recipes.
sources.notes: Public CSV is accessible without login, but no license or redistribution terms were found. Do not treat nutrition values as recipe ingredient quantities.

sources.license: unknown (no license tag and no dataset README/card file in repository metadata)
sources.dataQuality: Rows are multimodal conversation records with messages and image paths, not one row per recipe. In a 100-row sample, 34 distinct Markdown recipe headings appeared; 92 assistant texts contained quantity-like strings and 73 contained instruction-like terms. These sample heuristics are not corpus-wide estimates.
sources.notes: Hugging Face metadata reports 193k rows and a 529,439,151-byte JSON file, but no license/provenance. The full file was not downloaded; cannot report global distinct-dish or field-completeness counts.

sources.dataQuality: Page describes a nutrition database and lists categories, but no public dataset export or license was found.
sources.notes: No scraping or use of session cookies.

sources.sourceName: Copper — traditional dishes of the world
sources.dataQuality: The dataset contains 3 Vietnam catalog entries with name, total time, difficulty, normalized ingredient names and recipe URL. It does not include ingredient quantities or method text. Rows are catalog/ingredients-only, not full recipes.
sources.notes: Only the 3 country_code=VN rows are imported. Preserve source ID, source URL, CC BY 4.0 license and attribution in app data and UI. The publisher says the corpus covers up to three dishes per country, so it is not a comprehensive Vietnamese cuisine set.
